title: Wave-2 follow-up audit (zero-LLM): T2A anomaly, T3D-Escalate errors, and a 1/22 symptom-log integrity defect
headline_findings: T2A 9.1% condition DA is genuine over-conservatism, not a rendering bug: the block is short (454-739 chars) with f2p/p2p counts and failing ids in the first ~12 lines; nothing decisive is buried in logs (T2A has no tools, tool_calls=0).

20/22 served records are factually linked to the review patch; 2 (wrong_patch, wrong_patch_good) are deliberately re-identified records (linkage is unverifiable-by-design and truly mismatched). On the 20 linked records the model still abstained 19 times, citing linkage (19) / freshness (18) / coverage (~9).

Among those 19 linked-record abstentions: 3 explicitly ASSERT a sha/linkage mismatch that does not exist; 16 only say linkage "cannot be verified". The trigger is the literal block header "linkage not yet verified" with no tool to adjudicate it.

A single fixture defect found (1/22): fix_wrong_patch_05f2955c70897168 has session symptom metadata post_patch_passed=false (symptom persists -> gold REJECT, and this metadata drives the static diagnostic block and the consistency endpoint) but the served physical symptom log renders POST exit 0 (symptom gone), and that log hashes to the record digest. T2D/Strict/T3A reach REJECT via the metadata channel (matching gold), whereas Escalate reads the raw log and is therefore served contradictory symptom evidence.

Of 5 T3D-Escalate oracle errors, 1 (wrong_patch) is explained by that fixture defect; the other 4 are genuine model calibration errors (2 over-abstention on decisive failing checks despite incomplete coverage; 2 unsupported REJECT on raw failing lines outside the executed declared set).

t2a.institution_overreach: w2_stale_bad: the only REJECT; condition_gold=REJECT (all-red institutional record) but oracle=NEED_EVIDENCE (a persisting symptom is hidden) — the regime-relative nature of condition_gold in one cell.

rendering_facts.header_text: TEST ARTIFACT (ACCEPTANCE tier; full static record; linkage not yet verified)

t2a.interpretation: condition_gold is a NORMATIVE label: institutional presentation is defined as sufficient to commit in T2A even though linkage is not adjudicated. The model instead requires independently adjudicated linkage and converts the un-adjudicated caveat into abstention (occasionally into a false, specific mismatch assertion). This is the clearest evidence-policy-driven over-abstention in the pilot.

symptom_log_integrity.mechanics: Session symptom polarity (fixtures.symptom.post_patch_passed) drives the static diagnostic block and check_claim_consistency, while get_run_log(symptom) serves physical logs/<served_id>.symptom.log. For fix_wrong_patch_05f2955 the two disagree: metadata False (persists) vs physical POST exit 0 (gone). The physical log hash matches the served record log_digests, so the defect was baked in at build time, not introduced by the run.
symptom_log_integrity.observed_effect: T2D/Strict/T3A reach REJECT via metadata/static symptom (matching gold); T3D-Escalate reads the raw log (gone) and the acceptance record is unlinked/stale, so it abstains — counted as an error but actually consistent with the bytes it was served.
symptom_log_integrity.recommendation: Before external validation, align this fixture (physical symptom log should show POST exit 1 to match registered polarity, or correct the metadata/gold) and re-run ONLY its 5 cells; do not change any other fixture/gold. Requires a paid re-run -> needs separate approval.

Report the wrong_patch fixture defect and any exclusion/correction transparently; n=10 issues means one fixture moves condition DA by ~4.5 points.

The headline behavioral result survives the audit: abstention is driven by evidence policy wording and un-adjudicated linkage, and escalation grants access but does not by itself fix decision calibration.
